name: M6.Pinned.enumerator_sdiff
statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (B C : Finset (M6.Pinned.Vector m)) (P : M6.Pinned.Pins m), B ⊆ C → M6.Pinned.enumerator (C \ B) P = M6.Pinned.enumerator C P - M6.Pinned.enumerator B P
guidance: Use sum_sdiff after unfolding enumerator. Finset.sum_sdiff yields additive equality. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
